primary_analysis: For each environment seed, average the KPI across the five frozen PPO training-seed realizations, then perform paired inference across environment seeds. Use a hierarchical bootstrap over both training seeds and environment seeds for the primary weighted-tardiness confidence interval. Do not treat the 5 x N PPO observations as independent.
multiple_testing: Apply Holm correction to the family of PPO-vs-CP-SAT and PPO-vs-WEIGHTED_COMPOSITE weighted-tardiness tests across all ten final scenarios.
no_tuning_rule: No PPO hyperparameter, training seed, CP-SAT horizon/budget, fixed baseline, scenario definition, or final-test seed range may be changed after observing final-test outcomes.
